headline: Guild records on Thaddius and the Four Horsemen, on a night that lost its time to two trash wipes and a Sapphiron restart

mvp.headline: the raid's dispeller: 77 dispels, ten Life Drains on Sapphiron and a Rebirth
why: 77 dispels, the most in the raid, 18 more than the next (Osinir and Sixto, 59 each)
Removed 10 Life Drains on the Sapphiron kill and 5 Curses of the Plaguebringer on Noth

also.text: 417k on Thaddius and 217k on Patchwerk, the most damage in the raid on both
took 36 of the 51 Hateful Strikes on Patchwerk, Fenhir the other 15, nobody died
13 interrupts, the most in the raid, 6 of them Kel'Thuzad's Frostbolts

overview: 15 of 15 in 2:21:48, ten minutes over the usual night (2:11:25). Two guild records: Thaddius in 2:19, ten seconds under the old best of 2:29, on 55k raid DPS against a usual 32k, and the Four Horsemen in 3:53, one second under. Patchwerk (2:01 against a median 2:29), Grobbulus (1:17 against 1:38) and Faerlina (0:52 against 1:05) were all well under the usual too.

The time went elsewhere. Two trash wipes after Gothik, 21 deaths at 20:57 and 37 at 21:01, and a run back from the graveyard. Earlier, six died on the spider trash before Anub'Rekhan, Drikkle first, and Drikkle died again to the next pack of Necro Stalkers. Then a Sapphiron pull that was over in 38 seconds, and 22 minutes before the next one. 77 trash deaths in all, against 15 on 14 Oct.

World buffs: at Anub'Rekhan 38 of 40 had Rallying Cry and Zandalar, 37 Songflower, 20 Warchief's Blessing. As on 14 Oct the snapshots show almost none at Razuvious and Gothik (2 and 1), the usual sign of buffs stored in a Chronoboon, and they were back on 33 at the Horsemen. Warchief's Blessing was gone by Loatheb and Songflower by Sapphiron.

Warcraft Logs was down tonight, so this raid was read from the raw combat log. The parses are rough estimates from the guild's own past parses, not Warcraft Logs rankings, so the analysis leaves them out.

wipes.title: Sapphiron, pull 1 (Sapphiron at 99%)
wipes.whatHappened: Sapphiron's melee killed Birkler at 0:03 (15k in under three seconds, 77% to dead), then Groomz at 0:06. With both tanks gone he went through the casters: Utzemekanism at 0:09 and Osinir at 0:12 to melee, Speldosan at 0:18 to Cleave, Harrylarry at 0:23 to Life Drain. Twelve dead, raid DPS 2.4k, and the raid left the instance at 0:38.
wipes.likelyCause: The opening seconds on the tank. Birkler got 2.5k healing in the ten seconds before he died while taking 15k of melee, and Groomz 1.7k against 10.5k. The log shows the damage and the missing healing, not why the healing wasn't there: healers out of range or not ready at the pull would both look like this.
evidence: Birkler: 77% at -2.9 s, 38% at -1.1 s, dead at 0:03, 2.5k healing received
Groomz dead at 0:06 after 10.5k melee and 1.7k healing
Melee was 17% of all damage taken, against 6% on a usual kill; 5 deaths to melee, a usual kill has 0.1
On the kill 22 minutes later: no deaths, 9k raid HPS
wipes.avoid: Pull Sapphiron only when the tank healers have called ready and are in range. The second pull, with the same raid, had no deaths.

wentWell.text: Thaddius in 2:19, a guild record (old best 2:29, median 3:57), on 55k raid DPS. Chain Lightning hit 2.5 times per raider against a usual 6.7, and nobody died to a charge.
The Four Horsemen in 3:53, one second under the guild record. 505 Marks, 12.6 per raider against a usual 18.6, and 30 Meteors soaked by 15 raiders.
Patchwerk in 2:01 (median 2:29) with no deaths. Macharius took 36 Hateful Strikes and Fenhir 15.
Sapphiron on the second pull in 3:49 with no deaths. 71 Life Drains removed: Utzemekanism 16, Drikkle and Osinir 15 each, Etowa 10, Caesartje 9.
21 of Kel'Thuzad's 22 Frostbolts interrupted: Fluffycatto 6, Tochopolvo, Bruceli and Corvere 4 each.
